suite: Loss capture and workbook import V2.9

results.name: Source mapping captures all 18 fields without merging accounting dimensions
Money precision, calendar dates and source serials are validated
Risk mapping is optional; acceptance controls inclusion and integrity checks
Period discrepancy, near miss and investigation exceptions require explicit handling
Saved drafts retain step values and reject edits by another preparer
CSV accepts quoted commas and exact source headers; malformed input stays out
Repeated transactions across months are quarantined and inconsistent quarter data is visible
Distinct import events require unique references and a retained explanation
Unknown branches require explicit authorized mapping; imports do not verify recovery claims
Imported provenance survives acceptance while narrative recovery stays unverified
Source errors and unsupported currencies never create financial records
Loss routes show useful locations and register every rendered action
